capabilities: Builds a matrix from headings already written in literature notes
Shows per-paper badges for missing sections
Adds a missing heading to a note in one click
Filters, searches and sorts papers by title or property
Exports the matrix as a Markdown table or CSV
extras: States it works offline and never sends notes anywhere; exported matrix notes carry a literature-matrix-export property so they are not treated as papers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for comparing many literature notes side by side across the same sections, such as Method, Data, Findings and Gaps.
summary: Synthesis matrix that turns literature notes into a table of papers as rows and note headings as columns for side-by-side comparison.
